messages:
IncidentBot: [ALERT] GPU_POOL_EXHAUSTION us-east1-primary - queue_length=4200, avg_wait=12.4s, autoscaler_error=ReachedScaleLimit
olivia: seeing this on the dashboard. queue is skyrocketing. paging @sre-oncall
raj: ack oncall, grabbing the runbook. any customer-facing degradations yet?
sre-oncall: getting pages from PagerDuty. multiple 429s and timeouts for some heavy gen routes. marking P1 for impact
luis: autoscaler logs show repeated failures: 
```
Error: cannot allocate more instances - quota or scale cap reached (limit=160)
Trace: autoscaler/scale_loop.go:412
```
marie: is cross-region spillover configured? can we route to us-west1 or europe as overflow?
olivia: yes policy exists but last time we had a variant mismatch when falling back to us-west1-small. need to confirm model compatibility before routing traffic
raj: we should reduce in-flight tokens first to buy time. try setting per-instance max_concurrency=2 for affected model in us-east1, and throttle incoming queue to 1500 reqs/s
sre-oncall: applied throttling to ingress route /v1/generate (rate_limit=1500) — watch queue
incubot: Deploy-bot queued: rollback/autoscale-tweak config change requested by @sre-oncall
deploy-bot: started rollout: autoscale-config-update v=2026-03-15T12:45Z (canary 10%)
luis: can we enable "spillover_force" to us-west1 bypassing compatibility check? risk is different quantization, might increase latencies or produce nan probs
marie: do not force. instead, spin up fallback variant in us-west1 (quantized-4bit) and warm cache, then enable gradual spillover. I’ll kick off model spinup
olivia: good. who can watch customer impact? cc: @pd-bot for alert batching
pd-bot: PagerDuty: 6 customers affected, highest severity on /orgs/enterprise-3 - alerted sales-ops
raj: started warmup: POST /internal/models/spawn {"region":"us-west1","model":"gptx-lite-quant","replicas":8} — logs show provisioning started
sre-oncall: autoscaler in us-east still stuck at limit. created support ticket with infra quota team (TICKET-3892). adding quota request in parallel
luis: temporary mitigation: route 30% of overflow to us-west1-canary, 70% stays queued in us-east with throttles. Running AB test to confirm latency + correctness
marie: warmed cache on us-west1-canary. KV cache hit rate rising. ready to flip 30%
olivia: flipping spillover to us-west1-canary now: `POST /admin/routing/spillover -d '{"from":"us-east1","to":"us-west1","percent":30}'`
incubot: [INFO] spillover change applied: 30% -> us-west1-canary
raj: initial telemetry: latency+ p50 from 210ms -> 480ms on canary, p95 spikes to 1.9s, but error rate stable. quality checks running
sre-oncall: some logs show tokenization mismatch warnings for a subset of prompts (approx 2%). initiating regex filter to route those back to us-east1
luis: started automated rollback plan if error_rate > 5% or latency p95 > 5s. Threshold not hit yet
marie: customer impact update: enterprise-3 seeing higher latencies (~3-4s), but no errors after spillover. support notified customers in affected orgs via CSM notes
raj: autoscaler quota still pending. infra replied they can raise soft limit within 30 minutes if we provide justification and expected peak. I've submitted metrics link: https://dash.redwood.internal/metrics/1955551234
olivia: can we reduce quality or token budget for heavy requests temporarily? e.g., max_tokens=512 default for affected routes
sre-oncall: patch applied to route config: set max_tokens=512 for /v1/generate heavy model. queue length dropped to 1800
incubot: [UPDATE] queue_length us-east1=1800, us-west1-canary_inflight=430, overall avg_wait=6.1s
marie: recommend keeping spillover at 30% for 20-30 minutes, then slowly increase if canary p95 stabilizes below 2s
luis: +1. Also pushing lower-precision variant (gptx-lite-quant-3) to us-west1 if more headroom needed
olivia: status check: any routes still returning 429?
pd-bot: Alerts: 3 customers still experiencing 429 intermittently (enterprise-3 down to 1% of requests). PD escalated to oncall SRE and CSM
raj: preparing post-mortem draft. root causes: autoscaler hit hard limit in us-east1 (capacity quota) + insufficient warm standby in other regions + routing policy defaulted to strict compatibility and couldn't fail fast
sre-oncall: mitigation summary posted to incident channel: throttles, reduced concurrency, spillover canary, spinning fallback variants, quota request. will handoff to daytime SRE rotation in 20m
olivia: handoff ack. leaving notes: action required: - follow up with infra quota - validate cross-region variant compatibility matrix - add automated warm standby in top-2 failover regions - implement graceful fallback mode that prefers quantized-compatible variants
marie: customers updated. closing PD alerts after confirmation from enterprise-3 CSM.
incubot: [RESOLVE] incident status: monitoring. no new errors in last 5m. follow-up ticket TICKET-3892 for quota, TICKET-3893 for routing fallback work
olivia: thanks team. will add timeline to postmortem and tag eng-runtime + infra
raj: great work. short retro after doc is up. :thumbsup:
